subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should #41824 stay plugin-owned claim verification only, or should core add a narrow exact-run outbound delivery correlation seam so verifier plugins can safely gate Telegram/source turns?
rationale: VISION.md favors plugins for optional policy, but current hook types document that outbound delivery lacks reliable runId correlation, so automation cannot choose the product/API boundary.

options.title: Plugin verifier plus narrow seam
options.body: Claim-verification policy remains outside core, while core only exposes the exact run/outbound correlation needed for plugins to enforce it safely.

options.title: Plugin-only, no seam
options.body: Close or defer the core issue and accept that verifier plugins must use sessionKey despite the documented concurrency limitation.

options.title: Built-in core verifier
options.body: Treat false success claims as core runtime policy and design a first-party verifier with explicit config, migration, and live-proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Plugin verifier plus narrow seam
recommendation.body: Claim-verification policy remains outside core, while core only exposes the exact run/outbound correlation needed for plugins to enforce it safely.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is the same core-versus-plugin product boundary reflected in the #68051 close decision.
